The Silverhawk Cipete branch

A 1920s parlour for Cipete and the neighbourhoods of South Jakarta.

Same standard as every Gentology branch: a head-reading before each signature haircut, fades crafted low, mid or high on request, hands sanitised before every service and a disposable razor for every shave.

How booking works

There are no time slots. There is the list.

Gentology runs a waiting list, not appointments, and it is kept by phone. Ring the Silverhawk Cipete branch and the store manager puts your name on the board. There is no online booking on this site.

  1. Ring the branchAsk the store manager for your waiting-list number and estimated time.
  2. Expect some giveThe estimated time can move by up to an hour either way.
  3. Ring again if it is a while awayJoined more than four hours ahead? It is recommended to ring again at least an hour before your estimated time.

The tariff

Every head is read before it is cut.

Different head shapes need different approaches, so each haircut starts with a head-reading. Ask for a low, mid or high fade.

Gentology

Services, in Indonesian rupiah

Signature haircuts

  • Fade avant-garde signature haircutIDR 90k* (see the price note below)

    Low, mid or high fade, crafted on request.

  • Avant-garde signature haircutIDR 80k* (see the price note below)

    Starts with a head-reading, then detailed hair-crafting.

  • Add a hair wash to either haircut+ IDR 10k

Both signature haircuts include hair vitamin, hot towel, massage and pomade styling.

Other services

  • Traditional shavingIDR 30–60k
  • Hair tattoofrom IDR 60k
  • Hair polishIDR 80k

House rules

Five things we hold ourselves to.

I

Satisfaction

Three days of free repairs on any cut. Tell us what would make you happier and we will do what we can.

II

Precision

Barbermen trained to read your head shape, measure, consult and then cut in detail.

III

Fade

Trained and equipped to craft a great fade, whichever height you ask for.

IV

Hygiene

Hands sanitised before every service. A disposable razor for every shave.

V

Amenities

Free coffee, free infused water and an outdoor smoking lounge.
